_description: One row per piece of evidence supporting a field value in cases.csv, filing_events.csv, outcomes.csv, or transitions.csv. Provides auditability: every PARTIAL or VERIFIED field value must trace to at least one row here. Populated by edgar_evidence_finder.py and manually during verification.

evidence_id.description: Unique evidence row ID. SRC sequence resets per case.

case_id.description: Foreign key to cases.csv. One case may have many evidence rows.

evidence_type.description: Classification of the evidence artifact. RESEARCH_TARGET = expected evidence not yet located — placeholder for edgar_evidence_finder.py output.

source_name.description: Human-readable source label. E.g., 'SEC EDGAR', 'Yahoo Finance', 'Bloomberg Terminal', 'CRSP', 'PACER', 'Stooq'.

source_url.description: Direct URL to the evidence. For EDGAR: full index URL (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/{CIK}/{ACCESSION}/). For price data: query URL or note of data source. VERIFY_REQUIRED if not yet located.

filing_type.description: SEC form type if applicable. E.g., '8-K', 'SC 13D', '10-K', 'DEF 14A'. Null for price data or non-SEC sources.

filing_date.description: EDGAR filing date. This is the authoritative date — not press release date, not signing date.

accession_number.description: SEC EDGAR accession number. Required for EDGAR sources when verification_status=VERIFIED.

exhibit_number.description: Exhibit designator if evidence comes from a filing exhibit. E.g., '10.1', '10.2', '99.1'. Null if evidence is in the 8-K/13D body itself.

excerpt.description: Verbatim text excerpt from the source document. No paraphrasing. For RESEARCH_TARGET rows: describe what text is expected to be found.

supports_field.description: Pipe-separated list of cases.csv field names that this evidence directly supports. E.g., 'observation_date|source_filing_url|signal_type'. Used to verify completeness.

confidence.description: Confidence that this source correctly supports the listed fields. HIGH = verbatim match in primary document. MEDIUM = derived or calculated. LOW = inferred or secondary source.

verification_status.description: VERIFIED = source URL confirmed, excerpt extracted, field values populated. PARTIAL = source located but excerpt/URL incomplete. VERIFY_REQUIRED = research target (source expected but not yet found).

added_by.description: How this evidence row was created.

notes.description: Anything unusual about this evidence — ambiguous filing language, exhibit pagination, discrepancy between sources.

_usage_rules.minimum_evidence_for_partial: At least 1 VERIFIED evidence row supporting observation_date AND 1 supporting signal_type before case.data_quality can become PARTIAL.
_usage_rules.minimum_evidence_for_verified: All required fields in cases.csv must have at least 1 VERIFIED evidence row. price_at_signal requires either Bloomberg or yfinance evidence row.
_usage_rules.research_targets: RESEARCH_TARGET rows are pre-populated by edgar_evidence_finder.py and represent expected evidence. They do NOT count toward PARTIAL or VERIFIED thresholds until confirmation upgrades verification_status to VERIFIED or PARTIAL.
_usage_rules.anti_lookahead: Evidence rows must be dated to the contemporaneous source. A 2024 news article describing a 2021 event does NOT count as VERIFIED evidence for that event.
